proposed_widenings.name: triggered non-reaction magic-item ability
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a trigger-bound property that does not consume a Reaction, but the current magic-item triggered ability surface only models reaction-cost abilities.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one.

proposed_widenings.name: triggering save outcome override
proposed_widenings.justification: The current effect surface can negate or reflect a triggering spell, but it cannot convert the triggering failed saving throw into a success.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can turn your failed save into a successful one

notes: Cast Spell and Reflect Enchantment fit the existing composite magic-item surface, but Resist Enchantment does not. Per protocol, no content or trace files were authored.
